glosses: A ban or curse pronounced with religious solemnity by ecclesiastical authority, often accompanied by excommunication; something denounced as accursed.
Something which is vehemently disliked by somebody.

examples.text: Even three years ago, the thought of spending two hours, let alone a whole day, without my mobile would have been anathema.
